summary: The r450k static marketing site content (r450k/src/content/*.js) has been refreshed to reflect the suite's latest capabilities. Two new feature cards were added: 'Fleet maps & floor plans' (the myseliasan control plane now maps sites/buildings and edge nodes geographically, with an in-app per-building floor-plan designer, camera placement with field-of-view coverage cones, a building view aggregating multiple nodes' cameras, and click-to-locate / live view from the map) and 'Face recognition' (mymatasan edge nodes enroll known people and turn a detection into a named alert, entirely on-prem). The 'Unified notification feed' card now mentions per-camera filtering to isolate one camera's events, and the 'Fleet pairing over the LAN' card now mentions operator-gated per-node mTLS certificate auto-renewal so fleet trust stays current without manual re-pairing. The 'Multi-site fleets' use case and the myseliasan app card were enriched with the map/floor-plan capabilities. Two new inline SVG icons (map, face) were added to r450k/src/components/Icon.jsx for the new cards. All copy was translated across en/ms/zh/ar (English, Malay, Simplified Chinese, Arabic/RTL) at full parity.
compatibility: Frontend-only changes on the r450k static marketing site; no backend/Worker change and no impact on the Go apps or their versioned releases.
